metadata.description: Infrastructure: 224 bridges and viaducts of 3 km or more mapped in Wikidata (CC0), sized and colored by total length. Click a bridge for its photo (Wikimedia Commons). The longest are the high-speed rail viaducts of China and the sea crossings of East Asia and the Gulf.
